        function saveConsentToCookie(savedConsent) {
            if (!savedConsent) return;
            const oneMonthInMilis = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 30;
            const date = new Date();
            date.setTime(Date.now() + oneMonthInMilis);
            const setCookie = "lucid-cookie-consent=" + JSON.stringify(savedConsent) + ";";
            const basePath = "path=/;";
            const oneMonthExpiration = "expires=" + date.toUTCString() + ";";
            const secure = "secure;"

            
            document.cookie = setCookie + basePath + oneMonthExpiration + secure;
        }
        
        Osano.cm.addEventListener("osano-cm-consent-saved", saveConsentToCookie)
